frequency_question: How often do proposed severe tariffs go into effect within the specified short window rather than being delayed or superseded by negotiations?
membership_rule: Includes executive announcements of unilateral tariff rates of 25% or higher targeting a specific major trading partner with a stated deadline of 90 days or less. Excludes general multi-country legislative tariffs.
